user.title: Set up My Leviton (USB)
user.description: Scans the Leviton VRUSB stick for about {scan_sec}s, then matches each bus address to your local inventory by device ID (type / channel / id). Existing Home Assistant entity IDs and names are preserved.

data_description.New devices to import: Keep selected to import. Edit each Name field on this same screen (prefilled from the bus wire name when available).
data_description.Matched devices to rename (optional): Select matched devices whose Home Assistant friendly name you want to edit. Deselected matched devices are left unchanged (entities are never removed).
data_description.import_devices: Keep selected to import. Edit each Name field on this same screen (prefilled from the bus wire name when available).
data_description.rename_devices: Select matched devices whose Home Assistant friendly name you want to edit. Deselected matched devices are left unchanged (entities are never removed).

error.usb_error: Could not talk to the Leviton USB stick. Check that it is plugged in and not in use.

init.title: Rescan Leviton bus
init.description: Scan the USB bus again and match addresses to the current inventory. Existing entities are never removed. You can import new addresses and optionally rename friendly names.
